title: Assessing Deferred Interest When a Crestline Credit Card Promotional Period Ends
content:
On the closing date of the statement that follows the end of a deferred-interest plan's promotional period, Northgate assesses in one entry the interest the plan accrued since the purchase date when a balance was left on it at the end of the period, and the assessment may be posted at any time on that closing date. This schedule figures that assessment for a Crestline Credit Card account carrying at most one purchase on each deferred-interest plan, and the plan assessed is the one whose period has ended and that carries no assessment yet.

For a plan whose period ended with a balance left, and only for such a plan, the interest assessed in one entry on the closing date of the next statement is the figure Northgate's deferred-interest schedule works out, and the unpaid balance then becomes a standard balance; a plan whose balance left, as that schedule figures it, is not above zero is assessed nothing and its accruals lapse.

## At a glance

| Plan at the end of its period | On the next statement's closing date |
|---|---|
| a balance left | the deferred interest is assessed in one entry; the unpaid balance becomes a standard balance |
| balance left not above zero | nothing is assessed; the accruals lapse |

## Posting the assessment: `assess_deferred_interest_7b31b265`

**Capability.** Assesses the deferred interest of one promotional purchase on a Crestline Credit Card account. One call adds one deferred interest assessment entry to the account ledger, dated today, citing the promotional purchase it concerns, for the amount passed; it writes only that entry and changes no other record (the account record's stored balance field is not updated).

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_deferred_interest_7b31b265` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | reference number of the Crestline Credit Card account charged, read from the card account lookup | identifier text |
| `source_card_txn_id` | ledger entry reference number of the promotional purchase the interest concerns, read from the card ledger lookup of that account | identifier text |
| `amount` | the deferred interest assessed | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; kept rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (always "assessed" on success), `card_txn_id` (reference of the new assessment entry), `card_account_id`, `source_card_txn_id`, `amount` (USD, 2 decimals) and `txn_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). The call succeeds whenever the account, the purchase and the amount are supplied; the tool checks no condition and computes no figure.
